about.title: El Cerrito Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: El Cerrito is a compact Contra Costa County city, but everyday products still cause serious harm here — a kitchen appliance that overheats, a ladder that snaps, a car part that fails while someone's driving along I-80 or Potrero Avenue. Unlike many injury cases, California product liability claims frequently rely on strict liability, meaning the injured person generally doesn't have to prove the manufacturer was negligent — only that the product was defective and that the defect caused harm. That can include a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or inadequate warnings about known risks. Because these cases often involve manufacturers, distributors, and retailers spread across different states, and because the product itself becomes critical evidence, having knowledgeable guidance early matters. We handle product liability claims for El Cerrito residents and can evaluate what happened and explain the options available under California law.

whyChoose.title: What California Product Liability Law Means for You

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify the Path Forward
items.desc: Because California often applies strict liability to defective products, the focus is generally on the product's condition and the harm it caused, not on proving the manufacturer was careless.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which may widen the options available when pursuing a claim.

items.title: The Product Itself Is Key Evidence
items.desc: Preserving the item exactly as it was at the time of the injury can matter significantly, and we can advise on how to protect that evidence properly.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer knew about the defect?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Under California's strict liability approach, you generally need to show the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury, rather than proving the company acted negligently. We can review your situation and explain which theory best fits your facts.

items.question: What should I do with the product that caused my injury in El Cerrito?
items.answer: Try to keep the product exactly as it was when the injury happened, along with packaging, receipts, or instructions if you have them. Avoid repairing or discarding it, since it often serves as central evidence in these claims. Our team can advise on safe storage and next steps.

items.question: Does it matter that El Cerrito is a small city for this type of claim?
items.answer: No — product liability claims usually depend on where the product was made, sold, or used, not the city's size. Whether the incident happened near San Pablo Avenue, Potrero Avenue, or elsewhere in El Cerrito, the same California legal principles typically apply.

items.question: Is there a cost to contact us about my product liability claim?
items.answer: No. We offer free case reviews, and we generally work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation.
